description: Archived mission state reader (libs/core/foundation/archived-mission-state-capability.ts): read-only, tenant-bound (libs/core/authority.ts TENANT_BOUND_READER_ROLES). libs/core/mission/mission-decision-lock.ts loadDecisionCaseMissionState assumes it to read one archived tenant mission's active/archive/missions/<personal|confidential>/<tenant>/<id>/mission-state.json, always inside an exact read-only capability naming that file (plus product schemas). No write, no other file of the mission folder or archive, no mission lifecycle authority (it replaces the borrowed mission_controller role on that read).
